methodological.en: Her methodological approach to data collection greatly strengthened the validity of the study.
methodological.zh: 她在数据收集方面采用的方法论有力地增强了该研究的效度。

methodological.en: Reviewers criticized the paper for lacking methodological rigor in sample selection.
methodological.zh: 评论者批评该论文在样本选择上缺乏方法上的严谨性。

methodological.en: The team revised its methodological design after the pilot study revealed serious flaws.
methodological.zh: 试点研究暴露出严重缺陷后，团队修订了研究设计。

sustainable.en: The university adopted a sustainable model for managing its research funding.
sustainable.zh: 该大学采用了一套可持续的科研经费管理模式。

sustainable.en: Sustainable agriculture practices can reduce soil erosion and conserve water.
sustainable.zh: 可持续的农业做法能够减少土壤侵蚀并节约水资源。

sustainable.en: Without renewable energy sources, such growth will not be sustainable in the long term.
sustainable.zh: 如果没有可再生能源，这种增长从长远来看将无法持续。

cohesive.en: The research team maintained a cohesive argument throughout the entire dissertation.
cohesive.zh: 研究团队在整篇论文中保持了一个连贯统一的论证。

cohesive.en: Effective planning produced a cohesive strategy that united all department goals.
cohesive.zh: 有效的规划制定出一项凝聚各部门目标的连贯战略。

cohesive.en: The committee worked as a cohesive unit to approve the new budget.
cohesive.zh: 该委员会作为一个有凝聚力的整体通过了新预算。

discrete.en: The signal can be decomposed into a series of discrete components for analysis.
discrete.zh: 该信号可以分解为一系列离散的成分用于分析。

discrete.en: Each discrete stage of the pipeline was tested independently by the engineers.
discrete.zh: 流水线的每个独立阶段都由工程师单独测试。

discrete.en: The model treats these variables as discrete rather than continuous.
discrete.zh: 该模型把这些变量视为离散变量而非连续变量。

succinct.en: Her succinct summary made the complex findings accessible to a broad audience.
succinct.zh: 她简洁的总结使复杂的研究成果为广大读者所理解。

succinct.en: The reviewers requested a succinct statement of the study's main contribution.
succinct.zh: 评论者要求对该研究的主要贡献作出简明的陈述。

succinct.en: A succinct abstract is often all that reviewers read before deciding.
succinct.zh: 在决定之前，评论者往往只读一段简明的摘要。

substantive.en: The committee made a substantive change to the proposal after lengthy discussion.
substantive.zh: 经过长时间讨论，委员会对提案作出了实质性的修改。

substantive.en: The seminar offered substantive criticism rather than superficial praise.
substantive.zh: 这次研讨课给出的是实质性的批评而非表面的赞扬。

substantive.en: Her contribution to the debate was substantive and well documented.
substantive.zh: 她对这场辩论的贡献是实质性的，并且有充分文献支持。

tangible.en: The grant provided tangible support for graduate students conducting fieldwork.
tangible.zh: 这项资助为从事田野调查的研究生提供了实实在在的支持。

tangible.en: Policy makers want tangible evidence that the reform reduced unemployment.
tangible.zh: 政策制定者希望看到确凿证据，证明改革确实降低了失业率。

tangible.en: The agreement produced tangible results within a single year.
tangible.zh: 该协议在一年内就取得了实际成果。

transient.en: The early gains proved transient once the subsidy was removed.
transient.zh: 补贴取消后，早期的收益被证明只是短暂的。

transient.en: Most of the transient effects disappeared within a few weeks.
transient.zh: 这些短暂的影响大部分在几周内就消退了。

transient.en: Researchers distinguished transient noise from persistent signal in the data.
transient.zh: 研究人员将数据中的瞬时噪声与持续信号区分开来。

sequential.en: The sequential nature of the experiment means each trial depends on the previous one.
sequential.zh: 该实验的顺序性意味着每次试验都依赖于前一次试验。

sequential.en: Teachers presented the material in sequential order to build student understanding.
sequential.zh: 教师按顺序呈现材料，以逐步建立学生的理解。

sequential.en: Sequential approval is required before the grant funds can be released.
sequential.zh: 在拨款释放之前必须获得逐级批准。

overarching.en: An overarching theme of the volume is the relationship between technology and social change.
overarching.zh: 该文集的一个总括性主题是技术与社会变革之间的关系。

overarching.en: The overarching goal of the project is to reduce carbon emissions across the region.
overarching.zh: 该项目的根本目标是减少整个地区的碳排放。

overarching.en: These specific findings support the overarching argument of the paper.
overarching.zh: 这些具体发现支持了论文的总括性论点。

pervasive.en: Social media has become a pervasive influence on political opinion worldwide.
pervasive.zh: 社交媒体已成为对全球政治意见无处不在的影响力量。

pervasive.en: There was a pervasive smell of chemicals throughout the manufacturing plant.
pervasive.zh: 整个制造厂弥漫着刺鼻的化学品气味。

pervasive.en: The pervasive use of automation raises difficult questions about employment.
pervasive.zh: 自动化的普遍使用提出了关于就业的棘手问题。

profound.en: The discovery had a profound effect on the entire field of medicine.
profound.zh: 这一发现对整个医学领域产生了深远的影响。

profound.en: Her lecture offered profound insights into language acquisition.
profound.zh: 她的讲座对语言习得提出了深刻的见解。

profound.en: The war caused profound economic hardship across the region for decades.
profound.zh: 这场战争数十年来给该地区造成了深重的经济困境。

thereby.en: The researchers reduced sample sizes, thereby lowering costs and shortening timelines.
thereby.zh: 研究人员缩小了样本量，从而降低了成本并缩短了时间。

thereby.en: Refining the model improved accuracy, thereby strengthening the study's conclusions.
thereby.zh: 改进模型提高了准确度，从而强化了该研究的结论。

thereby.en: The team published its data openly, thereby encouraging independent replication.
thereby.zh: 该团队公开其数据，从而鼓励了独立的复现。

respectively.en: The two groups scored 82 and 74 points on the comprehension test, respectively.
respectively.zh: 两组在理解测试中分别得到 82 分和 74 分。

respectively.en: Growth and unemployment fell by three and two percent, respectively.
respectively.zh: 增长率和失业率分别下降了 3% 和 2%。

respectively.en: The first and second groups received five and ten hours of training, respectively.
respectively.zh: 第一组和第二组分别接受了 5 小时和 10 小时的培训。

similarly.en: Similarly, students in rural areas reported less access to laboratory resources.
similarly.zh: 同样地，农村地区的学生表示获得实验室资源的机会更少。

similarly.en: The second experiment produced similarly strong evidence for the hypothesis.
similarly.zh: 第二次实验为该假设提供了同样有力的证据。

similarly.en: Similarly, other studies have confirmed the link between sleep and memory.
similarly.zh: 同样地，其他研究也证实了睡眠与记忆之间的联系。

meanwhile.en: Meanwhile, other laboratories continued gathering data on the same species.
meanwhile.zh: 与此同时，其他实验室仍在收集同一物种的数据。

meanwhile.en: The talks continued for three days; meanwhile, the fieldwork was postponed.
meanwhile.zh: 会谈持续了三天，与此同时野外调查被推迟了。

meanwhile.en: Meanwhile, the government introduced subsidies for farmers facing severe drought.
meanwhile.zh: 与此同时，政府为面临严重干旱的农民发放了补贴。

arguably.en: This is arguably the most important limitation of the proposed framework.
arguably.zh: 这可以说是该拟议框架最重要的局限。

arguably.en: Her approach is arguably more suitable for small samples than large ones.
arguably.zh: 可以说，她的方法更适合小样本而非大样本。

arguably.en: It is arguably unfair to judge the design on its first year alone.
arguably.zh: 仅凭第一年的表现就评判这项设计可以说是不公平的。

presumably.en: The authors presumably had access to the original archival records.
presumably.zh: 这些作者大概可以查阅原始档案记录。

presumably.en: Presumably, the delay resulted from incomplete data supplied by the agency.
presumably.zh: 大概这一延迟是由于该机构提供的数据不完整所致。

presumably.en: The missing samples are presumably still stored in the university laboratory.
presumably.zh: 那些缺失的样品大概仍存放在该大学的实验室里。

predominantly.en: The sample consisted predominantly of graduate students from engineering disciplines.
predominantly.zh: 样本主要由工程学科的研究生组成。

predominantly.en: The findings apply predominantly to large urban institutions rather than small colleges.
predominantly.zh: 这些发现主要适用于大型城市院校，而非小型学院。

predominantly.en: Participants were predominantly drawn from households with high incomes.
predominantly.zh: 参与者主要来自高收入家庭。

simultaneously.en: The imaging system simultaneously recorded activity in twelve separate brain regions.
simultaneously.zh: 该成像系统同时记录了 12 个不同脑区的活动。

simultaneously.en: Two laboratories simultaneously tested the compound using slightly different protocols.
simultaneously.zh: 两个实验室同时用略有不同的方案测试该化合物。

simultaneously.en: The platform simultaneously tracks shipments, inventory levels, and customer returns.
simultaneously.zh: 该平台同时跟踪货运、库存水平与客户退货。

markedly.en: Recovery was markedly faster in households that received direct cash payments.
markedly.zh: 获得现金补助的家庭的复苏明显更快。

markedly.en: The revised design markedly improved the durability of the outer coating.
markedly.zh: 重新设计的方案明显提高了外层的耐久性。

markedly.en: Male and female participants differed markedly in their willingness to disclose.
markedly.zh: 男性和女性参与者在披露意愿上存在明显差异。

jointly.en: The two universities jointly supervise the doctoral program and share facilities.
jointly.zh: 这两所大学共同指导该博士项目并共享实验设施。

jointly.en: The agencies jointly funded the project and published a shared report.
jointly.zh: 这些机构联合资助了该项目并发布了一份共同报告。

jointly.en: The authors jointly developed the model and divided the writing equally.
jointly.zh: 作者们共同开发了该模型，并平等分担了写作工作。

mutually.en: The two agreements are mutually dependent and cannot be enforced separately.
mutually.zh: 这两份协议相互依存，无法单独执行。

mutually.en: Both sides remain mutually committed to the ceasefire and to further negotiations.
mutually.zh: 双方仍相互承诺遵守停火协议并继续谈判。

mutually.en: The criteria are mutually exclusive, so no candidate satisfies all of them.
mutually.zh: 这些标准彼此互斥，因此没有候选人能同时满足全部条件。

collectively.en: Taken collectively, the studies provide strong evidence for the original claim.
collectively.zh: 总体来看，这些研究为最初的论断提供了有力证据。

collectively.en: The departments collectively agreed to share a single data repository.
collectively.zh: 各部门一致同意共享同一个数据存储库。

collectively.en: Collectively, the team members raised nearly half of the required funding.
collectively.zh: 团队成员合计筹集了所需资金近一半。

uniformly.en: Measurements were uniformly high across all twelve laboratories involved in the trial.
uniformly.zh: 参与试验的 12 家实验室的测量结果一律偏高。

uniformly.en: Students performed uniformly better after receiving individualized feedback from instructors.
uniformly.zh: 在得到教师个性化反馈后，学生的表现一致地有所提高。

uniformly.en: Uniformly applied rules ensure that every applicant is evaluated on the same basis.
uniformly.zh: 统一适用的规则确保每位申请者都按同一标准接受评估。

by contrast.en: By contrast, the second cohort showed almost no improvement over the same period.
by contrast.zh: 相比之下，第二个队列在同一时期几乎没有改善。

by contrast.en: By contrast, rural clinics reported far shorter waiting times than urban hospitals.
by contrast.zh: 相比之下，乡村诊所报告的等候时间远短于城市医院。

by contrast.en: By contrast, the smaller model achieved higher accuracy while using fewer parameters.
by contrast.zh: 相比之下，较小的模型在参数更少的情况下达到了更高的准确率。

in contrast.en: In contrast, coastal ecosystems recovered more slowly after the warming event.
in contrast.zh: 与之形成对比的是，海岸生态系统在变暖事件后恢复得更慢。

in contrast.en: In contrast to earlier estimates, the new survey produced considerably lower figures.
in contrast.zh: 与早先的估计相比，新调查得出的数字要低得多。

in contrast.en: Male applicants dominated engineering, in contrast to nursing and primary education.
in contrast.zh: 与护理和初等教育不同，工程专业的申请者以男性居多。

in addition.en: In addition, the authors provide the raw data for independent verification.
in addition.zh: 此外，作者们还提供了原始数据以供独立验证。

in addition.en: The method reduces costs, in addition to shortening the waiting time for applicants.
in addition.zh: 该方法除了缩短申请者的等待时间外，还降低了成本。

in addition.en: In addition to funding, the foundation offers technical assistance to small enterprises.
in addition.zh: 除提供资金外，该基金会还为小型企业提供技术援助。

hence.en: The instrument lacked calibration; hence all readings from that week were discarded.
hence.zh: 仪器未经过校准，因此那一周的所有读数都被弃用了。

hence.en: Enrollment fell sharply; hence the university merged two smaller departments.
hence.zh: 入学人数急剧下降，因此该大学合并了两个较小的院系。

hence.en: The data were collected inconsistently; hence the authors recommend a cautious interpretation.
hence.zh: 数据收集不一致，因此作者建议谨慎解读。

given that.en: Given that the results were replicated twice, the finding appears highly reliable.
given that.zh: 鉴于该结果已被复现两次，这一发现看起来非常可靠。

given that.en: Given that funding may be withdrawn, the team decided to archive all materials.
given that.zh: 鉴于资金可能被撤回，团队决定将所有材料存档。

given that.en: Given that each participant met the criteria, the sample was highly homogeneous.
given that.zh: 鉴于每位参与者都符合标准，该样本高度同质。

even if.en: Even if the pilot fails, the lessons will inform the full trial.
even if.zh: 即使试点失败，这些经验也将为完整试验提供参考。

even if.en: Even if costs rise, the laboratory must maintain adequate sample storage.
even if.zh: 即便成本上升，实验室也必须维持足够的样本存储条件。

even if.en: Even if reviewers disagree, the authors believe the interpretation is defensible.
even if.zh: 即使评论者持不同意见，作者仍认为这一解读站得住脚。

even though.en: Even though the sample was small, the effect size was remarkably large.
even though.zh: 尽管样本量较小，效应量却相当大。

even though.en: Even though revenue grew, the company reported its first operating loss.
even though.zh: 尽管营收增长，该公司仍报告了首次经营亏损。

even though.en: Even though the two systems differ, they produce nearly identical outputs.
even though.zh: 虽然这两个系统存在差异，但它们产生的输出几乎完全相同。

so that.en: The instructions were written clearly so that graduate students could follow them.
so that.zh: 说明书写得很清楚，以便研究生能够照着操作。

so that.en: We added a control group so that the effect could be measured separately.
so that.zh: 我们增加了对照组，以便单独测量该效应。

so that.en: The form was shortened so that participants would complete it quickly.
so that.zh: 表格被缩短了，以便参与者能迅速填完。

as long as.en: As long as the sample remains sealed, the findings will remain reproducible.
as long as.zh: 只要样本保持密封，研究结果就仍然可以复现。

as long as.en: As long as funding continues, the archive will remain open to scholars.
as long as.zh: 只要资金持续供应，档案馆就会继续向学者开放。

as long as.en: As long as the assumptions hold, the estimate remains a reasonable approximation.
as long as.zh: 只要假设成立，该估计仍然是一个合理的近似值。

rather than.en: The team revised the hypothesis rather than discarding the original dataset.
rather than.zh: 团队修改了假设，而不是丢弃原始数据集。

rather than.en: We should measure energy loss rather than simply report total output.
rather than.zh: 我们应当测量能量损耗，而不是仅仅报告总产出。

rather than.en: The author argues for structural reform rather than incremental adjustment.
rather than.zh: 该作者主张进行结构改革，而不是逐步调整。

investigate.en: Regulators investigated the factory after receiving complaints about chemical discharges.
investigate.zh: 监管机构在接到关于化学品排放的投诉后调查了这家工厂。

investigate.en: The committee will investigate how the error entered the published dataset.
investigate.zh: 委员会将调查该错误是如何进入已发表数据集的。

investigate.en: Graduates should investigate primary sources before relying on secondary summaries.
investigate.zh: 毕业生在依赖二手概述之前应当查阅原始资料。

justify.en: The researchers must justify their choice of instrumentation before the review panel.
justify.zh: 研究人员必须在评审组面前说明选择该仪器设备的理由。

justify.en: The cost increase does not justify abandoning the long-term study.
justify.zh: 成本上升并不足以成为放弃长期研究的理由。

justify.en: Later critics questioned whether the original authors could justify their conclusions.
justify.zh: 后来的批评者质疑原作者能否证明其结论是合理的。

maximize.en: The scheduling algorithm aims to maximize the number of completed sessions.
maximize.zh: 该排程算法的目标是使已完成的会议数量最大化。

maximize.en: Farmers can maximize their yield by adjusting irrigation to local rainfall patterns.
maximize.zh: 农民可以通过调整灌溉来适应当地降雨模式，使产量最大化。

maximize.en: The design team restructured the interface to maximize efficiency during data entry.
maximize.zh: 设计团队重新设计了界面，使数据录入时的效率最大化。

minimize.en: Careful calibration helps minimize measurement error across the entire sample.
minimize.zh: 仔细校准有助于使整个样本的测量误差最小化。

minimize.en: The new protocol minimizes patient discomfort without sacrificing diagnostic accuracy.
minimize.zh: 新的操作规程在不影响诊断准确性的前提下尽量减轻患者不适。

minimize.en: Shipping by rail minimizes the carbon footprint of long-distance transport.
minimize.zh: 采用铁路运输可使长途运输的碳足迹降至最低。

modify.en: Researchers modified the original questionnaire after the pilot interviews revealed ambiguity.
modify.zh: 在试点访谈暴露出歧义后，研究人员修改了原始问卷。

modify.en: Engineers modified the housing to reduce noise from the adjacent road.
modify.zh: 工程师改造了住房，以减少相邻道路带来的噪声。

modify.en: The committee decided to modify the draft before circulating it to members.
modify.zh: 委员会决定在分发给成员之前对草案进行修改。
